items.detail: Ankle buckled with about 2:29 left in Wednesday's win over OKC after landing on Isaiah Hartenstein's foot; helped off, did not return, Finch had no update and there is no timetable yet.
Hamstring: was sent for imaging and the 76ers said they would update Thursday, so his Friday status at IND hinges on that result.
Day-to-day with an illness that kept him out of Wednesday's game vs. Miami.
Ankle injury in Wednesday's win over the Clippers; played only 9 minutes and did not return.
Listed out (heel) but was a full participant in Wednesday's practice and is projected to return Friday at SA; if he plays it trims usage for Grimes, LaRavia and Sexton.

note: Friday Nov 27 slate. No news found on Derrick White, Payton Pritchard or Jayson Tatum (Best Bets props): none have injury entries. Cade Cunningham's ESPN entry is self-contradictory (DTD, knee), so no item.
